narration.transcript: Want the look of old timber beams without the weight? Meet Heritage Timber from Ekena Millwork. Each beam is molded from real, weathered timber with no corner seams. Pick from six textures, Mina, salvaged timber, rustic sawn, resawn rip, reclaimed axe cut, and sanded smooth. Then a hand-stained finish, sandstone, Kona Brown, vanilla chai, warm caramel, natural white oak, smoky brown, or primed, ready to paint. Eight sizes, from 3.5 inches square to 9.5 by 11.5, in lengths from 4 to 24 feet. They're hollow, so they slide over a wood block on your ceiling and can hide wiring. And they ship fast, stained beams in 3 to 5 business days, primed in about 1 to 3 days. Order a sample and see it in your own light.
